meta.title: Shudflow — AI product advisor for online shops
meta.description: AI product advisor for online shops outside Shopify: register, tune the bot, embed one widget.

hero.title: AI product advisor for online shops outside Shopify
hero.subtitle: A shop owner signs up, uploads the catalog, tunes the bot (tone, language, look) and embeds a single widget. Shoppers get answers in the shop's language with products from the shop's real catalog.
hero.context: CEE e-commerce · own sites, Tilda, plain HTML · 2026

items.title: AI service
items.text: FastAPI, Claude, vector search over product embeddings.

items.title: Answer checking
items.text: A recommended product must exist in the catalog, and products over the shopper's stated budget are dropped. 10 of 10 test scenarios without invented products; 52 tests.

items.title: Answer records
items.text: Each answer records its outcome, model, token use and latency; the dashboard keeps them.

items.title: Checks on every pull request
items.text: Lint, type checks and tests run in CI before anything is merged.

items.title: Service image published from GitHub
items.text: Every push to main builds and publishes the container image.

items.title: Own sign-in and dashboard
items.text: Google sign-in, our own sessions, a read-only demo shop, team invitations.

items.title: Analytics
items.text: Visits and the sign-up funnel on self-hosted Umami, no third-party trackers.

items.title: First release
items.text: After a joint manual test session.

items.title: Model choice for shops, answers in the shopper's language, streaming answers
